thread:
maggie: Heads-up — Hummingbird just opened an escalation. Seeing p99 embedding latency spikes on Dedicated pool-5, customers getting intermittent timeouts. Need owners for routing/workaround and an ETA on PR #4123 (KV cache patch).

raj: I'm taking initial ownership. Will triage now and scope whether it's a runtime regression or model-side. Expecting a first update in ~2h. Adding @oliver for hotfix help.

oliver: I looked at the recent evict heuristics change (commit optimize-kv-evict). I can pull a hotfix branch if we confirm the leak path. Can someone drop a short log snippet from pool-5?

maggie: dropping logs from midnight->now (trimmed):
```
2026-03-24T01:58:12Z pool-5: kv_cache.size=1.2GB p99=320ms
2026-03-24T02:12:01Z pool-5: kv_cache.size=1.9GB p99=980ms ERROR timeout=10s
2026-03-24T02:40:03Z pool-5: influx of concurrent embed jobs from tenant hummingbird-cust
```

isa: oncall note — trend started ~02:10 UTC, steady climb in tail. We have autoscale headroom but routing extra instances doesn't help if KV memory growth is unbounded. Short-term options: 1) enable prefix-KV eviction (quick config toggle), 2) route hummingbird traffic to backup dedicated pool (pool-8) with reduced throughput, 3) temporary model downgrade to q4_8 quant variant.

product-ops: Hummingbird is on a Premium SLA (99.9%). They want a concrete ETA for a workaround we can communicate to CSM. If routing to pool-8 is feasible, what's the ETA and impact on latency?

sre-bot: [ALERT] High p99 latency detected for pool-5 — count(>900ms) spikes over 5m. Incident ID: INC-20260324-1145.

raj: Plan: (1) attempt prefix-KV eviction toggle as immediate hotfix (5-10m rollback window), (2) if that fails, route hummingbird to pool-8 (15-30m including traffic-shaping), (3) ship PR #4123 for KV leak fix as patch (canary same day).

oliver: I can prepare the hotfix branch now. Need one reviewer for quick +1 — @isa or @raj. I'll also prep a canary manifest for 10% traffic to pool-8.

isa: I'll review PR #4123 in ~30m and run the canary monitor. Also will stage a rollback plan for the toggle.

maggie: @product-ops, if we can promise routing to pool-8 within 30m and a hotfix canary same day, will that satisfy the customer communication? Need a templated note with ETA and what to expect. :thumbsup:

product-ops: Yes — we'll send a note: ETA 30m for temporary routing to reduce timeouts; full fix (PR + canary) targeted today EOD with follow-ups. Sending draft to @maggie in 10m.

raj: quick ops checklist I'm doing now:
- toggle prefix-KV-eviction -> will run on pool-5 (5m)
- observe p99 for 10m
- if no improvement, execute route-to-pool-8 play (15-30m)
- kick PR review and schedule canary

oliver: pinging @devex for any customer-side config we should be aware of. Also leaving a short runbook snippet here for the toggle:
```bash
# toggle eviction
curl -X POST https://control.internal/pools/pool-5/config -d '{"eviction": "prefix"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'
```

isa: I'll set up the canary dashboard and add a short alert if p99 > 700ms after toggle.

maggie: thanks everyone. Please post progress updates here. If routing goes live I'll let CSM and the account lead know so they can send the customer the note.

product-ops: Draft sent to @maggie, adding CSM to thread for visibility.

oliver: hotfix branch created: git/infra/kv-evict-hotfix branch, will push PR in ~20m.

raj: toggle in progress now (starting 1737806120). Monitoring.

sre-bot: [UPDATE] toggle applied to pool-5 at 1737806180.

maggie: any immediate effects on p99?

isa: seeing p99 drop from 980ms -> 340ms within 3m. Continued monitoring.

raj: if improvement holds for 10m we keep toggle; otherwise we route to pool-8. ETA on routing window still ~25m if needed.

product-ops: I'll prep the customer note with the 30m routing contingency and send as soon as you confirm routing decision.

maggie: great. tagging folks: @raj @oliver @isa please update when you have canary PR link and final routing decision.

oliver: PR #4123 -> https://git.internal/r/repo/pulls/4123 (draft), requested review from @isa and @raj.

isa: reviewed + left minor comments, will approve after tests pass.

raj: monitoring window complete — p99 stable at ~330ms. Holding toggle and continuing canary work.

maggie: closing loop: product-ops will notify customer with ETA 30m for routing fallback if needed; engineering committed to hotfix canary today and full patch rollout pending canary success. Thanks all.
